item.name: Battle Fury

effects.title: Quell
effects.text: Increases attack damage against non-hero units by 10 for melee heroes, and 5 for ranged.

effects.title: Cleave
effects.text: Deals 60% of attack damage as physical damage in a cone up to 650 around the target. Deals 40% against creeps. (Melee Only)

notes: Cleave damage goes through spell immunity.
If multiple sources of Cleave are present, each Cleave's damage is applied separately.
item.lore: The bearer of this mighty axe gains the ability to cut down swaths of enemies at once.
